fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix Inc (NASDAQ:SKHY) rose 3.8% to $127.30 in pre-market US trading following Nvidia's strong earnings announcement and substantial increase in memory supply commitments (from $279B to $390B).
fields.summary_ko.1: SKHY, as a major supplier of Nvidia's high-bandwidth memory (HBM), is expected to benefit from improved future demand visibility through multi-year memory procurement commitments as AI infrastructure expands.
